subject: Novaflow: appreciation options & donation split for case study
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@novaflow.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novaflow reference: appreciation options and donation split

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for agreeing to be a reference and for the time on the case study call last week. We really appreciate Novaflow sharing outcomes and allowing us to quote your team. As promised, here are the options we can provide as a thank-you — pick whichever you'd prefer and we'll action it: 

1) $500 account credit applied to your Redwood invoice (one-time).
2) $100 gift card per participating team member (max 4) + Redwood match $100 to a charity of your choice (we'll handle the donation and provide a receipt).
3) Donate the full $500 to a charity you select; we can provide the donation receipt to Novaflow for records.

Logistics notes:
- For credits: we can apply to the account within 5–7 business days.
- For donations: we need the charity name, address, and W-9 or equivalent (if US-based) to issue the grant/donation.
- For physical gift cards: shipping address and approximate name list.

Attached: advocacy_options.pdf (quick summary).

Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm which option you prefer?
- If you select donation (partial or full), please share the payee details and any required tax forms.

If it helps, I can loop legal for any paperwork, but typically we only need the charity W-9 and a contact email.

Thanks again — looking forward to finalizing and getting this out to you.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Advocacy Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachments: advocacy_options.pdf
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@novaflow.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 13:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Novaflow reference: appreciation options and donation split

Hi Grace —

Thanks — happy to confirm. Novaflow would like option 2 but tweaked: please apply $300 as account credit and donate $200 to a local climate nonprofit we support. We think that split covers both the company and team appreciation.

Charity details for the $200: GreenWays Foundation
Address: 88 Harbor St, Portland, ME 04101
Tax ID: 04-1234567
Contact: donations@greenways.org

We can provide W-9 if needed — I can attach it once you confirm who to send it to at Redwood. Also quick question: is there any embargo on publication of the case study or logo usage? We prefer a soft embargo of 7 days post-publish to coordinate internal comms.

Thanks — Marta
Marta Lopez
Director, Product Marketing
Novaflow
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Novaflow reference: appreciation options and donation split

Grace / Rishi —

Nice — the $300 credit / $200 donation split is straightforward. Grace, can you confirm account ID for Novaflow so we can tie the credit to the right billing entity?

Rishi — can you sign off on the promotional credit and confirm whether we need a short invoice-generation step? I’ve attached a quick note on charity documentation we usually request (charity_w9_request.txt). For donations we route through the Redwood Grants Team; they will need the charity W-9 and contact email to issue the gift and get a receipt. 

Timing: propose we apply the credit by Friday (8/14) and initiate the donation the following week once we have the W-9. Marta asked for a 7-day embargo on publication — that’s fine; we should note that in the case study doc.

Evelyn Hart
Head, Customer Experience
Redwood Inference
Attachments: charity_w9_request.txt
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@novaflow.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Bcc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novaflow reference: appreciation options and donation split

Hi Marta —

Thanks for confirming the split and for providing GreenWays details. We’ve approved the $300 promotional credit and I’ve attached the one-time credit invoice for your records (INV-20260812-credit.pdf). 

Credit details:
- Amount: $300 promotional credit
- Applied to account: Novaflow (account ID: NVF-7782)
- Reference: DEAL-2026-3321

Donation next steps:
- Please email the GreenWays W-9 to grants@redwood.ai (or reply here and I’ll forward to the grants team).
- Once received, Redwood Grants Team will issue the donation and send Novaflow a formal donation receipt. I’ve attached a donation-intent-form to capture payee confirmation if that’s easier.

We’ve respected the 7-day soft embargo in our notes and will not publish until you confirm.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: INV-20260812-credit.pdf, donation-intent-form.pdf

Hi Rishi —

Thanks — NVF-7782 is correct. I’ve just sent the GreenWays W-9 to grants@redwood.ai and completed the donation-intent-form (attached). Please confirm once the credit posts and when the donation has been made so I can close the loop internally.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to provide any final quote for the case study when you’re ready.

Best,
Marta
